Crispy tortilla cones filled with juicy spiced beef and topped with melted mozzarella 🧀🔥 The perfect crunchy snack or quick dinner that everyone will love. One bite and you’re hooked 🤤 Crispy Beef Cones (12 cones) Ingredients For the cones:  • 6 tortillas (25–30 cm / 10–12 inches)  • Toothpicks For the topping:  • Mozzarella cheese, 100 g  • Chopped parsley, 1 tsp For the beef mixture:  • Ground beef, 400 g(0.8lb)   • 1 yellow onion, finely chopped  • Garlic, 4 cloves, minced  • Red bell pepper, diced (about 1 small)  • Green bell pepper, diced (about 1 small)  • Tomato paste, 1 big tbsp   • Soy milk, 100 ml (~ ½ cup) Seasoning:  • Paprika, 1 tbsp  • Chili powder, 1 tsp  • Turmeric, 1 tsp  • Garlic powder, 1 tsp  • Black pepper, 1 tsp  • Garam masala, 1 tsp  • Salt, ½ tsp Instructions 1.⁠ ⁠Prepare the beef mixture:  • Heat a little oil in a pan over medium heat. Add the onion and sauté until soft.  • Add the minced garlic and cook 30 seconds until fragrant.  • Add the ground beef and cook until browned, breaking it apart as it cooks.  • Stir in tomato paste, soy milk, diced bell peppers, and all seasonings. Cook until slightly thickened. Remove from heat and let cool slightly. 2.⁠ ⁠Prepare the cones:  • Cut tortillas in half. Roll each half into a cone shape and secure the edge with a toothpick. Baking Method:  1. Preheat oven to 190°C (375°F).  2. Place cones on a baking tray lined with parchment paper. Lightly spray with cooking spray.  3. Bake for 10–12 minutes until crispy and golden.  4. Fill each cone with the beef mixture and top with mozzarella cheese.  5. Return to oven for 5 minutes until cheese melts.  6. Garnish with parsley and serve warm. Air Fryer Method:   1. Preheat air fryer to 180°C (356°F).  2. Lightly spray cones with cooking spray and place them in the air fryer basket. Make sure they don’t touch each other.  3. Air fry for 6–8 minutes until crispy and golden.  4. Carefully fill each cone with the beef mixture and top with mozzarella cheese.  5. Air fry again for 3–4 minutes until cheese melts.  6. Garnish with parsley and serve warm. #crispybeef #quickrecipes #easyrecipes #lazydinner #beefcones

Cheesecake caramel beurre salé  Ingrédients Caramel au beurre salé • 120 g de sucre • 80 g de crème liquide entière • 50 g de beurre demi-sel Le biscuit  • 250 g de biscuits spéculoos ou petits-beurre • 100 g de beurre fondu Crème cheesecake • 450 g de fromage  • 200 g de crème liquide entière à 30 % MG, bien froide • 20 g de sucre glace • 1 c. à café d'extrait de vanille Préparation Le caramel au beurre salé • Faire fondre le sucre à feu moyen dans une casserole jusqu'à obtenir un caramel ambré. • Ajouter le beurre puis la crème chaude  • Mélanger jusqu'à obtenir une texture lisse et homogène. • Laisser refroidir complètement. Le biscuit : • Mixer finement les biscuits. • Ajouter le beurre fondu et mélanger jusqu'à obtenir une texture de sable humide. • Répartir la préparation dans les moules tassant bien au fond et sur toutes les parois. • Placer au réfrigérateur pendant 30 minutes. La crème cheesecake • Fouetter le fromage avec la vanille et le sucre. • Monter la crème liquide bien froide en chantilly ferme. • Incorporer délicatement la chantilly à la préparation au fromage. 🇬🇧 Salted Caramel Cheesecake Ingredients Salted caramel • 120 g sugar • 80 g heavy cream • 50 g unsalted butter Biscuit • 250 g speculoos biscuits or petit-beurre biscuits • 100 g melted butter Cheesecake cream • 450 g cream cheese • 200 g heavy cream, 30% fat, very cold • 20 g powdered sugar • 1 tsp vanilla extract Preparation Salted caramel • Melt the sugar over medium heat in a saucepan until it turns amber. • Add the butter, then the hot cream. • Mix until smooth and homogeneous. • Let cool completely. Low effort, minimal cleanup and incredibly delicious🔥 Great to serve for large groups/gatherings at home Macros Per Wrap (10 Total) 423 Calories | 41g Protein | 25g Carbs | 18g Fat Ingredients (Makes 10 Wraps) Garlic Parmesan Chicken - 600g Raw Boneless Skinless Chicken Thighs, cut into cubes - 600g Raw Chicken Breast, cut into cubes - 2.5 Tsp Salt - 2 Tsp Chilli Flakes - 3 Tsp Parsley - 4 Tsp Italian Herbs - 3 Tsp Paprika - 4 Tsp Garlic Granules or Powder - 200g Grated Parmesan - 6 Tsp Olive Oil - Avocado Cooking Spray (use before baking) Garlic Pamesan Creamy Sauce - 350g Light Evaporated Milk - 2 Tsp Italian Herbs - 1 Tsp Garlic Powder - 1 Tsp Paprika - 80g Grated Parmesan - 100g Light Cream Cheese - 15g Light Butter Wraps & Filling - 10 Low Carb Wraps (Brand: Mission) - Shredded Lettuce - Chopped Tomatoes - Chopped Onions 👨‍🍳 Cooking Instructions 1. Ingredients Meat Mixture • 1 lb ground beef (85/15) • 1 small yellow onion, grated and squeezed dry • 5 garlic cloves, finely grated • 1 grated jalapeño • 2 tbsp tomato paste • ⅓ cup parsley, finely chopped • ¼ cup cilantro, finely chopped • 1 tbsp olive oil • 1 tbsp ice water • 1 tsp salt • 1 tsp black pepper • 2 tsp cumin • 2 tsp paprika • 1 tsp allspice • 1 tsp coriander • 1 tsp garlic powder • ¼ tsp cinnamon Other • 4 pitas, cut in half Garlic Tahini Yogurt Sauce • ¾ cup Greek yogurt • ¼ cup tahini • 3 garlic cloves, finely grated • Juice of ½ lemon • 1 tbsp olive oil • ½ tsp salt • ¼ tsp cumin • 2 tbsp parsley, finely chopped • 2 tbsp cilantro, finely chopped Instructions 1. Preheat oven to 350°F. 2. In a large bowl, mix together the beef, grated onion, garlic, jalapeño, tomato paste, parsley, cilantro, olive oil, ice water, and spices until fully combined and slightly sticky. 3. Cut the pitas in half and gently open each pocket (heat the pitas in the microwave for a few seconds first to make them easier to open). Spread a thin layer of the meat mixture inside each pita, then brush the outside generously with olive oil. 4. Heat a pan over medium heat. Cook the arayes meat side down first for 1–2 minutes until charred, then flip and cook each pita side until golden and crispy. 5. Finish in the oven for 15 minutes, or until the meat reaches 155°F internally. 6. While the arayes cook, mix together all sauce ingredients until smooth. 7. Brush the hot arayes with olive oil mixed with minced garlic and parsley, then serve with the dipping sauce. #easydinners #arayes #pita

Fruity Pebble Ice Cream Taco #shorts #food #recipe Full Recipe 👇🏿 Fruity Pebbles Choco Tacos Yield: 6–8 tacos TOOLS NEEDED Mixing bowls Fine mesh strainer Electric hand mixer Rubber spatula Waffle cone maker Taco shell holder Pastry brush Microwave-safe bowl Ice cream scoop or piping bag --- BEFORE YOU START - Keep the heavy cream very cold and stop whipping just under stiff peaks so the ice cream stays light and creamy. - Shape the waffle taco shells immediately while they are still hot. Once they cool, they will crack instead of bending. - Let the taco shells cool completely before adding the white chocolate, and keep them upright in a taco holder anytime they are setting or freezing. --- FRUITY PEBBLES ICE CREAM Ingredients 2 cups cold heavy whipping cream, divided 1 1/2 cups Fruity Pebbles cereal, for soaking 3/4 cup sweetened condensed milk 1/2 cup Fruity Pebbles cereal, finely chopped 2 tablespoons caramel sauce Instructions 1. Add 1 1/2 cups Fruity Pebbles to a bowl and pour about 1 1/2 cups of the heavy cream over the cereal. 2. Cover and refrigerate for 2–3 hours. 3. Pour the cereal and cream through a fine mesh strainer into a clean bowl. 4. Press down firmly on the soaked cereal with the back of a spoon or spatula to get as much of the Fruity Pebbles cream out as possible. 5. Discard the soaked cereal. 6. Add enough fresh cold heavy cream to the strained cream to bring it back up to about 2 cups total. 7. Whip the cream until it reaches just under stiff peaks. It should be thick and fluffy but still smooth. 8. Gently fold in the sweetened condensed milk. 9. Finely chop or crush 1/2 cup Fruity Pebbles. 10. Mix the cereal with the caramel sauce. 11. Fold the caramel Fruity Pebbles mixture into the ice cream. 12. Transfer to a freezer-safe container, cover, and freeze for 4–6 hours or until firm enough to scoop. --- WAFFLE TACO SHELLS Ingredients Prepared homemade waffle cone batter Instructions 1. Preheat your waffle cone maker. 2. Add enough batter to make a thin, even waffle and cook until golden brown. 3. As soon as it comes off the waffle cone maker, carefully fold it into a taco shape. 4. Place it in a taco shell holder or taco mold while it cools. 5. Repeat with the remaining batter and let all of the shells cool completely. --- WHITE CHOCOLATE COATING Ingredients 2 cups chopped white chocolate 1–2 tablespoons coconut oil Instructions 1. Add the chopped white chocolate and 1 tablespoon coconut oil to a microwave-safe bowl. 2. Microwave in short intervals, stirring between each one, until completely melted and smooth. 3. Add a little more coconut oil if needed to loosen the chocolate. 4. Brush a thin layer of white chocolate all over the inside of each taco shell, making sure to get down into the bottom curve. 5. Place the shells upright in a taco holder and freeze for about 10 minutes, or until the chocolate is firm. --- ASSEMBLY Ingredients Prepared Fruity Pebbles ice cream Prepared white chocolate-coated taco shells Remaining melted white chocolate 1 cup Fruity Pebbles cereal, crushed Instructions 1. Remove the ice cream from the freezer. If it is very firm, let it soften for a few minutes until it is easy to scoop. 2. Fill each taco shell with the Fruity Pebbles ice cream. 3. Press the ice cream gently into the center and sides so the taco is completely filled. 4. Smooth the exposed ice cream across the top. 5. Place the tacos upright in the taco holder and freeze until the ice cream is firm again, about 30–60 minutes. 6. Reheat the remaining white chocolate if needed. 7. Dip the exposed edge of each taco into the white chocolate, rotating from the top toward the bottom in a curved motion so the chocolate follows the shape of the taco. 8. Immediately sprinkle crushed Fruity Pebbles over the wet chocolate. 9. Return the tacos to the freezer until the chocolate is set and the ice cream is completely firm. 10. Keep frozen until ready to serve.

Tender stewed chicken and gravy recipe: Cook time: 80-90 mins  Servings: 6 Ingredients:  1/2 yellow onion  1/2 green bell pepper  1/2 red bell pepper  4 crushed garlic cloves  1/2 stick butter or olive oil  2 TBSP All purpose flour   6-8 boneless skinless chicken thighs  4 cups of chicken broth  Dried parsley  Seasonings: all purpose seasoning (such as natures seasoning or lawrys) onion & garlic powders, paprika, Italian seasoning, black pepper and if you don’t mind some spice toss in some Slap ya mama.  Directions: Season about 6-8 boneless skinless chicken thighs (depending on how many you’re serving) with all named seasonings. Marinate from 1 hour up to overnight. The longer the better. Use a Dutch oven or stock pot to sear the chicken in 2 TBSP of butter or olive oil. Sear for about 2-3 mins on each side on a medium high heat.  Remove chicken from pot. If you see little dark bits and pieces at the bottom of the pot leave it. It’s not burnt. That’s flavor that you want to keep in your pot to make the meal even more flavorful. It will deglaze and cook into the stew once you add your chicken broth.  In the same pot (without washing) on a medium heat add 1-2 TBSP of butter (depending on how much oil or butter you have left from searing the chicken). Add your peppers, onions and seasonings and cook down your peppers and onions for about 8-10 mins or until tender.  Once tender while still on a medium heat add in 1 TBSP of butter and whisk in 2 tbsp of flour to make a roux. Whisk frequently. Don’t walk away from your roux because this is A quick roux and can burn easily so watch it closely.  After about 5 mins you should have the color roux you want your gravy to be. For example if you want a dark brown gravy that roux should be dark brown.  After you’ve achieved that color add in 3 cups of chicken broth 1 cup at a time while stirring in between each cup. Season to taste with named seasonings.  Add in 3-4 crushed garlic cloves and a hefty TBSP of parsley. Put the lid on partially to bring this gravy to a simmer on a medium heat.  After about 10 mins add your chicken in and let it cook on a medium heat for 1 hour. Check it every 10 mins to make sure it doesn’t need more liquid. After your chicken is tender to your preference serve over rice or however you prefer.  **I served mine over white rice with loose, seasoned buttery corn and A blueberry loaf bread I made in the oven using Martha white blueberry cheesecake mix. Preheat oven: Set your oven to 375°F (190°C). 2. Season chicken: Toss chicken with salt, pepper, paprika, garlic powder, and olive oil. 3. Prepare rice: Spread uncooked rice in a greased baking dish. Add carrots, onions, butter, chicken broth, salt, and pepper. Stir together. 4. Prepare sauce: In a saucepan, combine honey, soy sauce, garlic, ketchup, vinegar, and ginger. Simmer for 2 minutes. Stir in cornstarch slurry and cook until slightly thickened. 5. Assemble: Place seasoned chicken over the rice and brush generously with honey garlic sauce, reserving some sauce for serving. 6. Bake: Cover tightly with foil and bake for 35–40 minutes. Remove foil and bake another 10–15 minutes, until the rice is tender and the chicken reaches 165°F internally. 7. Finish: Brush with reserved sauce (reheat it first if it touched raw chicken). Broil for 2–3 minutes until golden and sticky, watching carefully. 8. Serve: Sprinkle with chopped green onions and serve hot. Tip: If the rice needs more time, add a splash of hot broth, cover, and continue baking. For a glossy restaurant-style finish, brush the chicken with extra honey garlic glaze just before serving. Hamburger Steaks with Mushroom Gravy are the ultimate comfort food!  INGREDIENTS  2 lbs ground beef, formed into 6 patties  1 tbsp McCormick Hamburger seasoning 8 oz pack of mushrooms 2 tbsp butter 2 tbsp flour 1 tbsp minced garlic 1/2 cup beef broth 1 cup heavy cream 1/2 tsp each salt and pepper 1 tsp each garlic powder, onion powder, smoked paprika  1/2 cup of grated Parmesan cheese Dried parsley  INSTRUCTIONS  Form 2 lbs of ground beef into 6 (1/3 lb) burger patties and season both sides with burger seasoning. You'll be making this bowl of comfort all fall long. 🥣🍂 Beef and Dumplings is a hearty, comforting dish featuring tender shredded chuck roast and homestyle dumplings simmered in a rich, savory broth. 🧡 It’s the perfect stick-to-your-ribs meal for a chilly day. 🫂 Keep reading or tap the link in our bio for full recipe details! ⬇️ Ingredients: 1 1/2 tablespoons oil 1 2 1/2 to 3 pounds chuck roast 1 1/2 teaspoons kosher salt 1 teaspoon pepper 1 teaspoon garlic powder 1 teaspoon paprika 1 small onion, finely chopped 2 stalks celery, chopped 2 tablespoons butter 2 tablespoons flour 6 cups water, plus more as needed 2 tablespoons beef bouillon paste (such as Better than Bouillon) 1 can cream of mushroom soup 1(12-ounce) package frozen rolled dumplings Chopped parsley, for serving Directions: Heat oil in a Dutch oven over medium-high heat. While the pot is heating, season the roast all over with salt, pepper, garlic powder, and paprika. Place chuck roast in the Dutch oven and cook, undisturbed, until browned, 4 to 5 minutes. Flip and cook for another 4 minutes. Remove roast from the pot and set aside. To the drippings, add butter and allow it to melt. Add onion and celery and cook, stirring often until softened. Add flour and cook for about 1 minute longer. Whisk in water, bouillon, and mushroom soup. Bring mixture to a simmer, stirring occasionally. Return roast to pot and return to a simmer. Cover reduce heat and cook until roast is very tender, about 3 hours. Remove the roast from the pot. Shred the beef and discard any pieces of fat. Add meat back to the pot. Add additional water if desired to ensure there is plenty of broth to simmer the dumplings and increase heat to medium-high. Once pot comes to a boil, drop dumplings into the broth. Maintain a simmer and cook, stirring occasionally until dumplings are done, 30 to 40 additional minutes. Adjust liquid as necessary with more water or broth. Adjust seasoning if desired with more salt and pepper. Serve with fresh parsley. ✨ Recipe Inspiration: @dinnerin321 🎥: Nicole @nicolesperfectbite #soup #comfort #chuckroast #beef #dumplings #dinner #fall

You already know this Cowboy Mashed Potato Casserole is gonna be GOOD! 🤠 To get the recipe, click the link in @allrecipes bio or continue reading! ⬇️ Ingredients: cooking spray 6 strips bacon 2 pounds baking potatoes, peeled and chopped 1 (5 ounce) can evaporated milk or whole milk 2 tablespoons butter 1 1/2 teaspoons salt, divided 1/2 teaspoon freshly ground black pepper, divided 1 pound ground beef 1 cup chopped onion 1 green bell pepper, chopped 1 cup frozen whole kernel corn 2 cloves garlic, minced 1 1/2 teaspoons smoked paprika 1/4 cup barbecue sauce 1 tablespoon Worcestershire sauce 1 teaspoon Dijon mustard 1/2 cup shredded Cheddar or pepper Jack cheese 1/4 cup canned French fried onions 2 tablespoons finely chopped fresh parsley Directions: Gather all ingredients. Preheat the oven to 375 degrees F. Grease a 2-quart baking dish with cooking spray. Place dish on a baking sheet. Cook bacon in a large skillet over medium, turning occasionally, until crisp, about 10 minutes. Place bacon on a paper towel to drain. Drain all but 1 Tbsp of bacon fat in the skillet. Chop bacon when cool enough to handle. Meanwhile, bring a large pot of salted water to a boil. Add potatoes and return to a boil. Cook, covered, until potatoes are fork tender, 15-20 minutes. Drain potatoes. Return potatoes back to the pot along with evaporated milk, butter, 1/2 tsp salt, and 1/2 tsp pepper. Mash potatoes with a potato masher until smooth. Stir 1/4 c chopped bacon into mashed potatoes. Add ground beef, onion, and bell pepper to the skillet with reserved bacon fat. Cook over medium until meat is browned and cooked through, stirring occasionally, 8-10 minutes. Add corn kernels, garlic, and paprika to the skillet. Cook and stir for 1 minute. Stir in barbecue sauce, Worcestershire sauce, mustard, remaining 1 tsp salt, and 1/2 tsp pepper. Spread ground beef mixture in prepared baking dish. Spread potatoes evenly over beef. Sprinkle with cheese, remaining bacon, and French fried onions. Bake until bubbly and cheese is melted, 20-25 minutes. Garnish with parsley. 👨‍🍳: Nicole McLaughlin #cowboycasserole #mashedpotatoes #easydinners #dinnerideas

Dump & Bake Creamy Chicken & Orzo Creamy, cozy, packed with flavor, and the best part? Everything gets dumped into one dish. 🙌 Minimal prep, minimal cleanup, and absolutely no excuse not to have dinner on the table. Just try it! Ingredients * 1 cup dry orzo * 2 cups chicken broth * ½ cup heavy cream * Salt & pepper, to taste * Sun-dried tomatoes, as much as you like * 1 can artichoke hearts, drained * 1 large handful baby spinach * Chicken thighs * Garlic powder * Onion powder * Paprika * Olive oil * Grated Parmesan cheese Directions Preheat oven to 375°F. In a 9x13-inch baking dish, add the orzo, chicken broth, heavy cream, salt, pepper, sun-dried tomatoes, artichoke hearts, and spinach. Give everything a good mix. Season the chicken thighs generously with salt, pepper, garlic powder, onion powder, and paprika. Nestle them right into the orzo mixture and drizzle the tops with a little olive oil. Cover tightly with foil and bake for 30 minutes. Remove from the oven, take off the foil, and give the orzo a good stir around the chicken. Sprinkle with grated Parmesan and return to the oven uncovered for another 10 minutes, or until the chicken is cooked through and the orzo is tender and creamy. That’s it! Texas Fudge Ingredients Cheese Mixture 16 oz shredded sharp cheddar cheese 16 oz shredded Monterey Jack cheese 8 slices cooked bacon, chopped ½ cup chopped pickled jalapeños Liquid Mixture 1 (15 oz) can evaporated milk 2 large eggs ½ cup all-purpose flour Instructions 1. Prepare the Cheese Base In a large mixing bowl, combine the shredded sharp cheddar, shredded Monterey Jack, chopped bacon, and chopped pickled jalapeños. Mix everything together thoroughly and set aside. 2. Make the Liquid Batter In a separate bowl, whisk together the evaporated milk and eggs until well combined. Add the all-purpose flour and whisk until the mixture is smooth and no lumps remain. 3. Combine & Mix Pour the liquid mixture into the cheese mixture. Stir well until everything is evenly coated and fully combined. 4. Bake Preheat your oven to 350°F (175°C). Lightly grease a 9x13 baking pan. Pour the mixture into the prepared pan and spread evenly. Bake for 35–40 minutes, or until the top is golden and the center is set. 5. Cool & Serve Allow the Texas Fudge to cool completely before cutting. If you cut it too early, it will not hold its shape.
